svg.text: ShotStopper Micra Interlock v2.0 - schematic (netlist: design.py)
PS1 is fed from J7 only: on USB power alone the paddle sensing is off.
D5 and D1 stop either supply back-feeding the other. F1: resettable fuse.
ESP32-C3, USB, reset and status LED
shield to GND through R8 1M and C7 4.7n
IO8 is also a boot-mode pin: use BOOT with the paddle off.
IO5 high opens K1: the machine sees the paddle as off.
IO5 low or undriven (R9): K1 is closed, paddle works as stock.
Paddle on: about 1.4 mA flows ISO5V, R10, U1, D4, paddle switch, COMMON;
U1 pulls SENSE low. Paddle off: D4 blocks, nothing flows in the machine's line.
J4 pin 1 black (common), pin 4 yellow (paddle input on CN9).
Measured on CN9: 5 V pull-up through about 10 k; a short to common = paddle on.
